LanguageData.VFEI2_PherocoreChelis.description: A pheromone controlling micro-organ. It is necessary to construct certain types of insectoid hives. Pherocores have been embedded deep into the brains of geneline leaders which allowed ancient civilizations to control the hives.\n\nThis pherocore belongs to the great geneline from the planet Chelis, known for their locust-like appearance and ability to fly for thousands of miles.
LanguageData.VFEI2_PherocoreChelis.label: chelis pherocore
